expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes the captured page error after clicking, "PAGEERROR: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12", and says "JSON.parse throws a SyntaxError".

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply says "app.html:5 passes an incomplete JSON string to JSON.parse. The closing brace is missing" and quotes `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');`.
